rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted observation points is within the threshold.
Checks that MaxDate is consistent across Area_FloodEvent and Count_FloodEvent.
Ensures flood observations cover the current calendar year (or prior year in January).

params.condition: CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month'))
